VAULT_ADDR.description: Where the cluster is. An address, and required beside the token: neither works alone.

VAULT_TOKEN.description: Authenticates the caller. Unlike most credentials here it expires by default and is renewed rather than replaced, so a leaked one stops working on its own schedule. Root tokens can be set never to expire and are for setup only.

VAULT_NAMESPACE.description: Which namespace, on Enterprise. A path, not a credential.
